message: Fixed and verified. Settle up now leaves everyone square with nothing owed.

plan.title: Rounding error after Settle up leaves $0.01 owed instead of $0.00
plan.url: 127.0.0.1:5174 - shown in address bar as 'Lisbon trip - Tally | 127.0.0.1:5174'
plan.expected: After clicking `Settle up` all balances should be $0.00 / `owes nothing` / `all settled up`. No one should be owed anything. Suggested payments ($33.33 each) should fully settle Alex.
plan.actual: After clicking `Settle up` the Balances panel does NOT settle to zero. It shows: `Alex is owed $0.01`, `Sam owes nothing`, `Jo owes nothing`. `Settle up` remains enabled. Balances should be $0.00 / all settled but $0.01 remains due to rounding error on $100.00 / 3.

steps.instruction: Navigate to Lisbon trip group from fresh load
Click Description input [placeholder 'e.g. Dinner at Taberna']
Verify Paid by selector is 'Alex' [default - do not change] - Split equally between everyone
Click 'Settle up' blue button in Balances panel

before.evidence: Balances panel shows 'Alex is owed $0.01', 'Sam owes nothing', 'Jo owes nothing' with 'Settle up' still enabled, and Expenses shows 'Dinner $100.00' plus two '$33.33 Settle up payment' entries matching REFERENCE

fix.root_cause: `splitEvenly` rounded every share with `Math.round`, so $100/3 gave three $33.33 shares totalling $99.99 and leaving $0.01 unbalanced.
fix.summary: Changed `splitEvenly` to use floor plus distributing the leftover cents one each to the first members so shares always sum to the expense amount.
fix.message: Fixed by muse-code; tests pass and the regression test fails on the old code.

after.evidence: AFTER Balances panel shows 'Alex owes nothing', 'Sam owes nothing', 'Jo owes nothing' and 'All settled up Everyone is square. Nice trip!' with no 'is owed $0.01' and no Settle up button
